svg.title: Adaptive Boss Fight: a Unity boss whose abilities, narration and music adapt to how the player fights
svg.desc: Adaptive Boss Fight: a Unity boss whose abilities, narration and music adapt to how the player fights

g.text: GRADUATION PROJECT · GAME AI AND AUDIO
Co-developed a real-time Unity boss that turns combat data into a 16-feature
behavioral profile. A PyTorch classifier sorts the player into four playstyles,
and the boss's abilities, narration and music adapt. Batched telemetry keeps
AI work off the frame-critical path.
GRADUATION PROJECT · GAME AI AND AUDIO
